name: Control focus settle
visual_behavior: Scale 1.00 to 1.025 with border energy gathering toward the pointer

name: Primary press
visual_behavior: Control depresses 2 mm then releases without overshoot

name: Panel originate
visual_behavior: Morph outward from the invoking control or world referent rather than appearing independently

name: Panel dismiss
visual_behavior: Collapse toward its source while preserving the source in view

name: Acquire brackets
visual_behavior: Four corner brackets travel inward and resolve without blinking or perpetual pulsing
reduced_motion_behavior: Single 220 ms fade to final brackets

name: Candidate resolve
visual_behavior: Existing acquisition lines morph to amber dashed contour and leader card

name: Confirm referent
visual_behavior: Dashed amber contour becomes solid green through a traveling line fill

name: Invalidate referent
visual_behavior: Contour loosens and retracts into the observation node while identity remains in timeline

name: Confidence update
visual_behavior: Dash spacing opacity and label qualifier interpolate on the same anchored object

name: Guide path build
visual_behavior: Chevrons grow sequentially from current focus toward target with restrained cadence
reduced_motion_behavior: Static path fades in over 220 ms

name: Guide occlusion
visual_behavior: Path is continuously depth-occluded with a faint edge hint only near reappearance

name: Target arrival
visual_behavior: Final chevron compresses into a stable target ring

name: Evidence capture seal
visual_behavior: A thin frame closes around the evidence region then docks a thumbnail into the timeline

name: Provenance reveal
visual_behavior: Observation interpretation and action nodes unfold along the existing leader line

name: Cancel retract
visual_behavior: All visuals sharing the action ID retract together toward referent or source control

name: Tracking hold
visual_behavior: Anchor freezes at last trustworthy pose while its border softens

name: Relocalizing tether
visual_behavior: Anchor desaturates to 55 percent and gains a restrained tether to recovery tray

name: Anchor rebind
visual_behavior: Content interpolates from held pose to corrected world pose with speed-limited easing

name: Recovery tray dock
visual_behavior: World card glides to a screen-relative tray retaining identity reason and cancel control

name: Capability degrade
trigger: A source or service becomes unavailable
visual_behavior: Affected controls soften and group under one persistent degraded-mode pill

name: Capability restore
visual_behavior: Degraded pill resolves and affected controls regain state without rearranging layout

name: Workflow advance
visual_behavior: Active rail line flows to next stage and the previous stage becomes a stable completed node

name: Timeline replay scrub
visual_behavior: World actions interpolate or reconstruct deterministically from event timestamps
reduced_motion_behavior: Discrete event steps with short fades

name: Assistant evidence update
visual_behavior: Existing assistant card rearranges and morphs its source chips without replacement

name: Safety attention
visual_behavior: One expansion into stable red state followed by slow breathing luminance no blinking
reduced_motion_behavior: Stable red state with no breathing

name: Reduced motion transition
visual_behavior: All active loops settle gracefully at their stable final states
